name: Problems Jogo
summary: A game of precision and patience designed to be intentionally frustrating. The player's goal is to guide the character along a narrow sand path to the finish flag. Stepping on the grass results in immediate failure, forcing a restart of the level. As the game progresses, the character's size and movement change drastically to make advancement more difficult.
